about_the_game:
You are a candle, slowly melting in real time. Your mission is to explore a series of eerie and atmospheric locations, solving intriguing puzzles along the way. But be quick—time is not on your side! To survive, you’ll need to bend time and space, think creatively, and use every element of your surroundings to your advantage.

As you progress, you’ll unravel a gripping tale filled with unexpected twists, betrayal, and... vegetable murders? That’s right! In this bizarre world, you’ll uncover dark secrets, witness berry dismemberment, and experience other absurd yet strangely captivating events.

Features:

  • Real-time melting mechanic.

  • Atmospheric locations filled with mysteries and secrets.

  • Time and space manipulation to solve puzzles.

  • An unusual story with elements of dark humor and absurdity.

You made it to the end? Wow! Most people just watch the trailer. Some check the screenshots. Almost no one reads the description. ◕‿◕

Have a great day! If you try the game, may your candle burn bright (but not too fast!). And please, add the game to your wishlist. I'm a small indie dev, and it means a lot to me. (｡◕‿‿◕｡)

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 860
  • DirectX: Version 11
